faqs.question: What is the Chemspeed CRYSTAL POWDERDOSE used for?
faqs.answer: It's a fully automated, compact benchtop system for gravimetric solid dispensing, used for sample, reaction, and formulation preparation, dosing directly into vials and well plates.

faqs.question: What's the dispensing range?
faqs.answer: From milligrams up to 20 g, on the same system.

faqs.question: Does it dose directly into the vial, or does it require a manual transfer step?
faqs.answer: It doses directly into the vial rack or well plate, drastically reducing dosing cycle time compared to weigh-then-transfer methods.

faqs.question: Is the system fully automated?
faqs.answer: Yes, it automates repetitive dosing tasks and supports genuine walk-away operation.

faqs.question: Is the software regulatory-compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes, the software is 21 CFR Part 11 compliant, built for consistent and traceable operation.

faqs.question: Can it support DoE-style dosing studies?
faqs.answer: Yes, gradient and incremental value dispensing run through a clear, intuitive GUI built to speed up DoE setup.

faqs.question: What does the Storage Extension add?
faqs.answer: Capacity for up to 48 ready-to-dispense solid compounds, enabling longer unattended operation and greater experimental flexibility.

faqs.question: Can the system be monitored remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes, web and mobile access supports remote configuration and system status checks.

faqs.question: Does it integrate with other software?
faqs.answer: Yes, native ARKSUITE integration handles data, inventory, product, and run management, and the system connects to third-party software as well.

longForm.heroHook: Milligrams to 20 grams. Dosed straight into the vial. Walk away.
longForm.heroLead: Manual powder weighing eats hours that should go to actual science. CRYSTAL POWDERDOSE ends that, a fully automated, compact benchtop system that doses solids directly into vial racks and well plates with genuine gravimetric accuracy, from milligrams up to 20 g, in one continuous run. Dispensing straight into the vessel cuts dosing cycle time dramatically, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliant software makes every run traceable without extra paperwork. Gradient and incremental dispensing built into an intuitive GUI turns DoE studies from a manual chore into a few clicks, and an optional Storage Extension holds up to 48 ready-to-dispense compounds for genuinely unattended, high-throughput operation.
